scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved from the canonical nested-neighborhood representation by an exact support classification, a disjoint-block factorization, and a first-active-vertex recurrence. Prior chain-graph maximal-independent-set structure and general random-greedy work are credited explicitly rather than presented as new.
limitations: The statement is restricted to connected chain graphs.
The exhaustive checker covers order at most eight and is a stress test, not the proof of the infinite family.
Targeted literature searches covered chain/Ferrers/difference/2K2-free terminology, but historical indexing under other terminology remains a residual originality risk.

title: Exact random-greedy maximal-independent-set law on chain graphs
